Thanks to House Democrats’ efforts to lower health care costs for every American family, the #ACA marketplaces are more affordable than ever for Oregonians. Enrollment runs NOW through DECEMBER 15th for coverage starting at the beginning of 2024! 

Visit https://t.co/QpQDecgqs9 ! https://t.co/yZPcRdsKuV

Today is the 51st anniversary of #RoevWade and @GOP continues to push us closer to a nationwide abortion ban. I am proud to champion a woman’s right to make decisions about her reproductive healthcare. https://t.co/xBnsQYnQQO

I met with Sheriff Landers while in Newport, discussing public safety and the fentanyl crisis. We need to continue highlighting prevention efforts and raising awareness of available treatment options throughout our community. https://t.co/Wb8MvLxd9G

I had the pleasure of meeting with @umpquacc students this morning to talk about the issues important to them, including the values and impact of apprenticeship programs, healthcare workforce programs, and expanding our public transit options. https://t.co/K6JrOlOfmb
House Democrats continue to deliver. With the American Rescue Plan and the Inflation Reduction Act, we've lowered health insurance costs for 15 million Americans. https://t.co/R8e2PFpsVf
While Republicans keep talking about gutting Social Security and Medicare, @POTUS just released a budget that will protect these hard-earned benefits. https://t.co/w0VHFWMQ7j

President Biden’s budget will:

👩‍👦 Expand the Child Tax Credit
🎒 Make childcare more affordable
💲 ️ Protect Social Security and Medicare

This week marks the 14th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act. This landmark legislation has had a real impact on people's lives, with over 46 million Americans receiving coverage. We need to continue working to provide quality and affordable health care for all.  #ACA14 https://t.co/KPYV16pSo1

I’m proud to have secured $2 million for the Curry Health Network Chemotherapy Treatment Project. Currently, residents living on the South Coast have to travel hours to get needed cancer treatments. This funding will help patients get this lifesaving treatment closer to home. https://t.co/hNph5OVz88

I was honored to host a roundtable discussion with @Labor_Caucus, @CWAUnion and call center workers from Maximus to hear about working conditions and their fight for fair treatment on the job. #UnionProud https://t.co/Nq59cEkCrc

Health care decisions should be made between patients and providers, NOT judges and politicians. 

https://t.co/HahqXnkT2Q

PSA for House Republicans:  

Keep your hands off of Social Security and Medicare
Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, people in #OR04 insured through the ACA will save an average of $1,070 a year on their health insurance. https://t.co/5QrmiM28Nc

To commemorate Mental Health Awareness Month, I joined my Mental Health Caucus colleagues to remind everyone that mental health is as important as physical health.

If you or a loved one is experiencing a mental health crisis, you can call 988 for 24/7 support. https://t.co/GOqTh16a2Y
The latest episode of Cooking with Val is out now! I was joined by my fellow freshman and office neighbor, @RepJasmine, to talk about reproductive health access. https://t.co/ZaCqzJ6KxR

Over 1 million PACT Act claims have been approved since @POTUS signed this legislation into law in 2022. Thanks to the PACT Act, veterans who were exposed to toxic substances are finally getting access to the healthcare and benefits they deserve.

https://t.co/hfxm7Q6R47

House Republicans once again dropped the ball on bipartisanship. Today’s MilCon-VA funding bill will restrict reproductive health care services and slash funding for housing, food aid, and education for servicemembers, veterans and their families. 

I’m voting NO.

2 years ago, SCOTUS overturned Roe v. Wade and unleashed anti-choice extremist attacks on women’s reproductive freedom across the country. I’m standing alongside @DemWomenCaucus & @ProChoiceCaucus to make sure women have access to the reproductive health care they need.

The @USDA’s Farm to School grants program helps provide hands-on opportunities for students to learn about nutrition and local agriculture. I’m thrilled to see $189,414 headed to #OR04 to support this critical work. https://t.co/AQMXmbVRmW

#OTD in 1965 the Medicare and Medicaid Act was signed into law. This landmark legislation provides health care coverage for seniors, those with disabilities, and people with limited incomes.

I will continue fighting to defend and expand these programs. https://t.co/wEsYVOnMzq

Because of the #InflationReductionAct, @POTUS was able to announce that Medicare reached an agreement to lower the price of 10 of the highest-cost prescription drugs.

This announcement is lowering costs and putting #PeopleOverPolitics.

I joined Sheriff John Hanlin, Commissioner Tom Kress and county officials to talk about funding for a new radio tower. This project will provide emergency communications coverage to rural communities currently lacking radio coverage in Northern Douglas County. https://t.co/JD08unVE0x

#OTD 2 years ago, the Inflation Reduction Act was signed into law.     

This bold legislation is lowering healthcare costs, supporting job creation, and making the largest investment in tackling the climate crisis in our nation's history. Let’s keep up the work. https://t.co/HnoLr0z3dD

⬇️ Check out how much Oregonians in #OR04 are saving on health care costs because of the Investing in America Agenda. 

I’m fighting to strengthen the middle class, make health care more accessible, and lower costs for all Americans. https://t.co/ZS2n1BY5L0

Happy Women’s Equality Day! Alongside my @DemWomenCaucus colleagues, I am fighting for policies that protect, secure and expand women’s rights and freedoms, including access to reproductive healthcare. https://t.co/rSF4nAb8AU
